summary: Off-registry HTTP dependency source delivers unpinned code at install time
details: package.json line 12 declares the package's only dependency, "linker-client-string-async", as a bare URL on a third-party host (https://artifacts.koliroute.com/npm/linker-client-string-async) instead of a registry version range. npm install fetches whatever bytes that URL returns and installs them, executing any lifecycle scripts they contain, with no version pin, no integrity hash, and no registry provenance. The content served at that URL is mutable, so the code installed can change at any time without any change to this package. The shipped payload is a 55-byte index.js containing only module.exports = require('linker-client-string-async'), and the metadata is placeholder material (description "Generated package", author "Package Registry", repository github.com/example/...), so the manifest's dependency line is the entire functional surface of the release. The host is unrelated to any declared repository or homepage.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
